target_dataset: Custom VM Telemetry (45 samples: 13 Benign, 32 Malware)

primary_shift_drivers: Baseline Process Count Shift: Windows 11 clean VM baseline maintains 70-150 processes and 45,000+ handles, whereas MalMem's older Windows 10 VirtualBox baseline shows only 40-50 processes and 9,000 handles. XGBoost split rules trained on MalMem may treat legitimate Windows 11 service processes as anomalous.

Omission of Fileless Indicators: Model lacks anomalous_ppid_count, elevated_privilege_count, and suspicious_dll_count. It cannot inspect parent-child process spoofing or token elevation, relying solely on volumetric handle and thread counts.
